the identification and characterization of the variable regions of monoclonal antibodies to DNA.
the identification of idiotopes and the definition of their relationship to one another.
the definition of idiotopes on the variable region of monoclonal antibodies and the use of anti-idiotypes to study the relationship of the variable region to the antigenic specificity of an antibody.

the variable region of 16/16 contains two idiotopes, each with a reciprocal idiotope, and that the variable regions of M-2 and M-16 contain complementary idiotopes.
